source.text: יְהוָ֣ה מָ֭לָךְ יִרְגְּז֣וּ עַמִּ֑ים יֹשֵׁ֥ב כְּ֝רוּבִ֗ים תָּנ֥וּט הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH reigns; let [the] peoples tremble; [he is] sitting [on the] cherubim; let the earth quake.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns; let the peoples tremble! \q [He is] enthroned [on the] cherubim; let the earth quake!
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King; let the peoples shudder! \q He is seated on the cherubim as on a throne; let the earth shake!
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! The nations should tremble. \q He sits on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} throne above the winged cherubim. The whole earth should shake!

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ; que les peuples tremblent ! \q [Il est] assis [sur les] chérubins ; que la terre chancelle !
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ; que les peuples frémissent ! \q Il siège sur les chérubins comme sur un trône ; que la terre vacille !
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! Les nations devraient trembler. \q Il est assis sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trône au-dessus des chérubins ailés. Toute la terre devrait trembler !

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala; mataifa na yatetemeke! \q [Ameketi juu ya] makerubi; nchi na itikisike!
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme; mataifa na yatetemeke! \q Ameketi juu ya makerubi kama juu ya kiti cha enzi; nchi na itikisike!
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! Mataifa yanapaswa kutetemeka. \q Ameketi katika kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha enzi juu ya makerubi wenye mabawa. Dunia yote inapaswa kutikisika!

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina; ¡tiemblen los pueblos! \q [Está] entronizado [sobre los] querubines; ¡que se estremezca la tierra!
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey; ¡que se estremezcan los pueblos! \q Está sentado sobre los querubines como en un trono; ¡que tiemble la tierra!
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey! Las naciones deberían temblar. \q Él se sienta en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trono sobre los querubines con alas. ¡Toda la tierra debería temblar!

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trị vì; hãy để các dân run sợ! \q [Ngài] ngự [trên các] chê-ru-bim; hãy để đất rung chuyển!
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Vua; nguyện các dân run rẩy! \q Ngài ngự trên các chê-ru-bim như trên ngai; nguyện đất rúng động!
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Vua! Các dân tộc phải run sợ. \q Ngài ngồi trên ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, phía trên các chê-ru-bim có cánh. Cả trái đất phải rung chuyển!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다스리신다. 백성들은 떨어라! \q [그분께서] 그룹들 위에 앉아 계시니, 땅은 흔들려라!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이시다. 백성들은 떨어라! \q 그분께서 그룹들 위 왕좌에 앉아 계시니, 땅은 흔들려라!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이시다! 민족들은 떨어야 한다. \q 그분께서 날개 달린 그룹들 위 왕좌에 앉아 계신다. 온 땅은 흔들려야 한다!

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} reina; tremam os povos! \q [Ele está] entronizado [sobre os] querubins; estremeça a terra!
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é Rei; que os povos estremeçam! \q Ele está sentado sobre os querubins como num trono; que a terra trema!
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é Rei! As nações deveriam tremer. \q Ele está sentado no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} trono acima dos querubins com asas. A terra inteira deveria tremer!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ነገሠ፤ ሕዝቦች ይንቀጥቀጡ! \q በኪሩቤል ላይ [ተቀምጧል]፤ ምድር ትናወጥ!
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ንጉሥ ነው፤ ሕዝቦች ይርበድበዱ! \q በዙፋን ላይ እንደሚቀመጥ በኪሩቤል ላይ ተቀምጧል፤ ምድር ትናወጥ!
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ንጉሥ ነው! ሕዝቦች ሊንቀጠቀጡ ይገባቸዋል። \q ክንፍ ካላቸው ኪሩቤል በላይ በዙፋኑ ተቀምጧል። ምድር ሁሉ ልትናወጥ ይገባታል!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राज्य करते हैं; देश-देश के लोग काँपें! \q [वे] करूबों पर विराजमान [हैं]; पृथ्वी डोले!
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राजा हैं! देश-देश के लोग थरथराएँ! \q वे करूबों पर ऐसे विराजमान हैं जैसे सिंहासन पर; पृथ्वी हिल उठे!
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राजा हैं! राष्ट्र काँपें। \q वे पंखवाले करूबों के ऊपर अपने सिंहासन पर विराजमान हैं। सारी पृथ्वी डोल उठे!

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} царствует; пусть дрожат племена! \q [Он] восседает на херувимах; пусть сотрясается земля!
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Царь; пусть содрогнутся племена! \q Он восседает на херувимах, как на престоле; пусть земля дрожит!
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — Царь! Народы должны трепетать. \q Он сидит на своём престоле над крылатыми херувимами. Вся земля должна дрожать!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は王として治められる。もろもろの民は震えおののけ！ \q [その方は]ケルビムの上に座しておられる。地は揺れ動け！
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ王である。もろもろの民はおののけ！ \q その方は、ケルビムの上に王座を据えて座しておられる。地は震えよ！
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}こそ王だ！国々の人々は震えおののくべきだ。 \q その方は、翼のあるケルビムの上の王座に座っておられる。全地は揺れ動くべきだ！

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} царює; нехай тремтять народи! \q [Він] сидить [на] херувимах; нехай здригнеться земля!
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — Цар; нехай здригаються народи! \q Він сидить на херувимах, як на престолі; нехай трясеться земля!
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — Цар! Народи мають тремтіти. \q Він сидить на своєму престолі над крилатими херувимами. Уся земля має здригатися!

decisions.choice: reigns: is King, has taken the throne
decisions.reason: The verb (malak) with the LORD as subject is the cry of Psalms 93, 96, 97 and 99. The same form was shouted when a new king took the throne (2 Samuel 15:10; 2 Kings 9:13), so it may also mean "has become King": the LORD is acclaimed as King over all the earth.

decisions.choice: enthroned on the cherubim: above the ark
decisions.reason: The cherubim were two winged figures of gold on the cover of the ark of the covenant. The LORD was pictured as seated above them, as on a throne, and spoke from there (Exodus 25:18-22; 1 Samuel 4:4; 80:2).
The psalm is built around the cry "holy is he" (verses 3, 5, 9), as in Isaiah 6:3.
Balanced and Readable say "is King", the plain sense of the royal cry; Literal keeps "reigns".
Readable says what sitting on the cherubim means (m2).
The cherubim are the winged figures above the ark (see the meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps the name Bible readers know, and Readable adds "có cánh" (winged), as the English Readable does.
As the Korean Hebrews 9:5: "그룹" is the Protestant Korean form of the name; Readable adds "winged", as the English Readable does (meaning decision m2).
The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: "the LORD reigns" as "ነገሠ" (Literal), "ንጉሥ ነው" (Balanced, Readable), as 97:1
decisions.reason: The same royal cry as 97:1 and 1 Chronicles 16:31, in the same words at each level.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} राज्य करते हैं" (L); "... राजा हैं!" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The cry of the kingship psalms (meaning m1) keeps the one wording of 93:1, 96:10 and 97:1. The cherubim are "करूब", as on the ark in Exodus in this translation (meaning m2).
The royal cry keeps one wording per level through Psalms 93 and 95-99, as 1 Chronicles 16:31.
'Ammim are "племена" where the English Literal and Balanced say "peoples", by the rule recorded at Psalm 96:3 (also verses 2-3); Readable follows its English "nations" with "народы".

decisions.choice: YHWH malakh as 93:1, 96:10, 97:1; yoshev keruvim "ケルビムの上に座しておられる" (L, B as 80:2, 1SA 4:4, 2KI 19:15), "翼のあるケルビムの上の王座に座っておられる" (R)
decisions.reason: The kingship cry keeps one form through Psalms 93-99 (m1, uncertain); enthroned on the cherubim is above the ark (m2), in the form already used in 80:2 and Samuel-Kings; R adds the wings as the English R.

source.text: יְ֭הוָה בְּצִיּ֣וֹן גָּד֑וֹל וְרָ֥ם ה֝֗וּא עַל־כָּל־הָֽעַמִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH in Zion [is] great, and exalted [is] he over all the peoples.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} in Zion [is] great, \q and exalted [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} over all the peoples.
en.B: In Zion {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} towers over all the peoples.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great in Jerusalem. \q He rules high above all the nations.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} en Sion [est] grand, \q et élevé [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} au-dessus de tous les peuples.
fr.B: En Sion, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} domine tous les peuples.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand à Jérusalem. \q Il règne bien au-dessus de toutes les nations.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika Sayuni [ni] mkuu, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ametukuka juu ya mataifa yote.
sw.B: Katika Sayuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} yuko juu sana ya mataifa yote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu katika Yerusalemu. \q Anatawala juu sana ya mataifa yote.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en Sion [es] grande, \q y exaltado [está] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sobre todos los pueblos.
es.B: En Sion {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se eleva por encima de todos los pueblos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande en Jerusalén. \q Él gobierna muy por encima de todas las naciones.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Si-ôn [là Đấng] vĩ đại, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [được] tôn cao trên mọi dân.
vi.B: Tại Si-ôn, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vượt cao trên mọi dân tộc.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Ngài cai trị cao trên mọi dân tộc.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 시온에서 위대하시고, \q 그분은 모든 백성 위에 높으시다.
ko.B: 시온에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고, \q 모든 백성 위에 우뚝 높으시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 예루살렘에서 위대하시다. \q 그분께서 모든 민족 위에 높이 계셔서 다스리신다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} em Sião [é] grande, \q e exaltado [está] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} acima de todos os povos.
pt.B: Em Sião {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é grande; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se eleva acima de todos os povos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é grande em Jerusalém. \q Ele governa muito acima de todas as nações.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በጽዮን ታላቅ [ነው]፤ \q እርሱም ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ በላይ ከፍ ያለ [ነው]።
am.B: በጽዮን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ታላቅ ነው፤ \q ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ በላይ ከፍ ብሏል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በኢየሩሳሌም ታላቅ ነው። \q ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ በላይ ሆኖ ይገዛል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सिय्योन में महान [हैं], \q और वे सब देशों के लोगों के ऊपर ऊँचे [हैं]।
hi.B: सिय्योन में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} महान हैं; \q वे सब देशों के लोगों से बहुत ऊँचे हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यरूशलेम में महान हैं। \q वे सब राष्ट्रों के ऊपर ऊँचे पर से राज्य करते हैं।

ru.L: Велик {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} на Сионе, \q и вознесён {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} над всеми племенами.
ru.B: На Сионе {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} возвышается над всеми племенами.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} велик в Иерусалиме. \q Он правит высоко над всеми народами.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はシオンにおいて大いなる方、 \q その方はすべての民の上に高くおられる。
ja.B: シオンで、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は偉大な方。 \q その方は、すべての民の上にそびえておられる。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、シオンで偉大な方だ。 \q その方は、すべての国々の上に高くおられて、治めておられる。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} на Сіоні великий, \q і піднесений {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} над усіма народами.
uk.B: На Сіоні {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} височіє над усіма народами.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} великий у Єрусалимі. \q Він править високо над усіма народами.

decisions.choice: Zion: the hill of the temple
decisions.reason: Zion is the hill in Jerusalem where the temple and the ark stood, the place of the LORD's throne on earth (verse 1).
The word (ram) means high; the King in Zion is high above all nations.
Readable names the city.

decisions.choice: Tsiyyon "シオン" at every level (R too, where the English R says Jerusalem); ram "高くおられる" (L, R), "そびえておられる" (B)
decisions.reason: Zion is the hill of the temple (m1); the Psalter keeps シオン in R as well. Exalted is high, lifted up (m2).

source.text: יוֹד֣וּ שִׁ֭מְךָ גָּד֥וֹל וְנוֹרָ֗א קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them give thanks to your name, great and to be feared; holy [is] he.

en.L: Let them give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, great and to be feared. \q Holy [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}!
en.B: Let the peoples give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, great and awe-inspiring. \q He is holy!
en.R: Let the nations praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are great and fill people with awe. \q He is holy!

fr.L: Qu’ils rendent grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, grand et redoutable. \q Saint [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} !
fr.B: Que les peuples rendent grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, grand et redoutable. \q Il est saint !
fr.R: Que les nations {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louent, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es grand et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} remplis les gens de crainte. \q Il est saint !

sw.L: Na walishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, kuu na la kuogopwa. \q Yeye [ni] mtakatifu!
sw.B: Mataifa na yalishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, kuu na la kutisha. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!
sw.R: Mataifa na yakusifu, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mkuu na unawajaza watu hofu takatifu. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!

es.L: Que den gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, grande y temible. \q ¡Santo [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!
es.B: Que los pueblos den gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, grande e imponente. \q ¡Él es santo!
es.R: Que las naciones {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alaben, porque eres grande y llenas a la gente de asombro. \q ¡Él es santo!

vi.L: Nguyện họ cảm tạ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, [là danh] vĩ đại và đáng kính sợ. \q Ngài [là] thánh!
vi.B: Nguyện các dân cảm tạ danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, danh vĩ đại và đáng kính sợ. \q Ngài là thánh!
vi.R: Nguyện các dân tộc ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại và khiến người ta kính sợ. \q Ngài là thánh!

ko.L: 그들이 크고 두려운 주님의 이름에 감사하게 하십시오. \q 그분은 거룩하시다!
ko.B: 민족들이 크고 두려운 주님의 이름에 감사하게 하십시오. \q 그분은 거룩하시다!
ko.R: 민족들이 주님을 찬양하게 하십시오. 주님은 위대하시고 사람들이 우러러 두려워할 분이십니다. \q 그분은 거룩하시다!

pt.L: Que eles deem graças ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, grande e temível. \q Santo [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}!
pt.B: Que os povos deem graças ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, grande e temível. \q Ele é santo!
pt.R: Que as nações {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvem, pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és grande e enches as pessoas de temor. \q Ele é santo!

am.L: ታላቅና የሚፈራ ስምህን ያመስግኑ። \q እርሱ ቅዱስ [ነው]!
am.B: ሕዝቦች ታላቅና የሚያስፈራ ስምህን ያመስግኑ። \q እርሱ ቅዱስ ነው!
am.R: ታላቅ ስለ ሆንክና ሰዎችን በአክብሮት ፍርሃት ስለምትሞላ ሕዝቦች ያመስግኑህ። \q እርሱ ቅዱስ ነው!

hi.L: वे तेरे महान और भययोग्य नाम का धन्यवाद करें। \q वे पवित्र [हैं]!
hi.B: देश-देश के लोग तेरे महान और भय-भरे आदर के योग्य नाम का धन्यवाद करें। \q वे पवित्र हैं!
hi.R: राष्ट्र तेरी स्तुति करें, क्योंकि तू महान है और लोगों को आदर-भरे भय से भर देता है। \q वे पवित्र हैं!

ru.L: Пусть благодарят {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя, великое и грозное. \q Свят {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}!
ru.B: Пусть племена благодарят {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя, великое и внушающее благоговение. \q Он свят!
ru.R: Пусть народы хвалят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} велик и вызываешь у людей благоговение. \q Он свят!

ja.L: 彼らが、あなたの大いなる、恐るべき名に感謝するように。 \q その方は聖なる方！
ja.B: もろもろの民が、あなたの偉大で、畏るべき名に感謝するように。 \q その方は聖なる方！
ja.R: 国々の人々が、あなたをたたえるように。あなたは偉大で、人々に畏れを抱かせる方だから。 \q その方は聖なる方！

uk.L: Нехай дякують {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} імені, великому й грізному. \q Святий {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}!
uk.B: Нехай народи дякують {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} імені, великому й грізному. \q Він святий!
uk.R: Нехай народи хвалять {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} великий і сповнюєш людей благоговінням. \q Він святий!

decisions.choice: your name ... holy is he: a change of person
decisions.reason: The psalm speaks to God ("your name") and then about him ("holy is he"), a shift common in the psalms. The refrain "holy is he" is addressed to the hearers.
God's holiness is his utter difference from everything he made, and his purity. The refrain answers the song of the seraphim, "Holy, holy, holy" (Isaiah 6:3).
"Them" are the peoples of verse 2.
Readable says "you" for "your name", which stands for God himself.

decisions.choice: The first line speaks to God in 합쇼체; the refrain "그분은 거룩하시다" speaks about him in the plain style
alternatives: one speech level for the verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew moves from "your name" to "holy is he" (meaning decision m1); Korean marks the change of person with the speech level, and the refrain keeps one form in verses 3, 5 and 9.

decisions.choice: the refrain "holy is he" as "እርሱ ቅዱስ [ነው]" (Literal), "እርሱ ቅዱስ ነው" (Balanced, Readable) in verses 3 and 5
decisions.reason: The refrain speaks about God after the line speaks to him (meaning decision); Amharic keeps the shift with the third-person "እርሱ" and the same words each time, so the refrain is heard.

The psalm speaks to God ("your name") and then about him to the hearers ("holy is he", meaning m1). Hindi shows the change by the devotional "तू" and the honorific "वे". The refrain "वे पवित्र हैं!" has one form in verses 3 and 5 and grows in verse 9 (meaning m2 there).

decisions.choice: Refrain qadosh hu' "その方は聖なる方！" at every level, the same in 99:5 and close to 99:9
decisions.reason: The person changes from 'your name' to 'holy is he' (m1), kept as in the Hebrew; the refrain (m2; m3 of 99:1) keeps one wording.

source.text: וְעֹ֥ז מֶלֶךְ֮ מִשְׁפָּ֪ט אָ֫הֵ֥ב אַ֭תָּה כּוֹנַ֣נְתָּ מֵישָׁרִ֑ים מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה בְּיַעֲקֹ֤ב׀אַתָּ֬ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] strength of [the] king loves justice. You, you have established uprightness; justice and righteousness in Jacob you, you have done.

en.L: And the strength of the King loves justice. \q You have established uprightness; \q justice and righteousness in Jacob {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done.
en.B: Mighty King who loves justice, \q it is {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who have set fairness firmly in place; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done what is just and right in Jacob.
en.R: Mighty King, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} love justice. \q You have made fairness firm and sure. \q Among Jacob's people, Israel, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done what is right and fair.

fr.L: Et la force du Roi aime le droit. \q C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as établi la droiture ; \q le droit et la justice en Jacob, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui [les] as faits.
fr.B: Roi puissant qui aimes le droit, \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fermement établi l’équité ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait en Jacob ce qui est juste et droit.
fr.R: Roi puissant, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aimes la justice. \q Tu as rendu l’équité solide et sûre. \q Chez le peuple de Jacob, Israël, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait ce qui est juste et équitable.

sw.L: Na nguvu ya Mfalme inapenda hukumu. \q Wewe umethibitisha unyofu; \q hukumu na haki katika Yakobo {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umezitenda.
sw.B: Ee Mfalme mwenye nguvu unayependa haki, \q ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyeuweka usawa imara; \q umetenda yaliyo ya haki na ya kweli katika Yakobo.
sw.R: Ee Mfalme mwenye nguvu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unapenda haki. \q Umeufanya usawa kuwa imara na thabiti. \q Kati ya watu wa Yakobo, yaani Israeli, umetenda yaliyo ya haki na ya usawa.

es.L: Y el poder del Rey ama la justicia. \q Tú has establecido la equidad; \q justicia y rectitud en Jacob has hecho {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.
es.B: Rey poderoso que amas la justicia, \q eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quien ha afirmado la equidad; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho lo que es justo y recto en Jacob.
es.R: Rey poderoso, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} amas la justicia. \q Tú has hecho que la equidad sea firme y segura. \q En el pueblo de Jacob, Israel, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho lo que es justo y recto.

vi.L: Và sức mạnh của Vua yêu công lý. \q Ngài đã lập vững sự ngay thẳng; \q công lý và sự công chính trong Gia-cốp, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.B: Lạy Vua quyền năng, Đấng yêu công lý, \q chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thiết lập sự công bằng vững chắc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm điều công minh và chính trực giữa Gia-cốp.
vi.R: Lạy Vua quyền năng, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} yêu công lý. \q Ngài đã làm cho sự công bằng được vững chắc. \q Giữa dân Gia-cốp, tức là Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm điều ngay thẳng và công bằng.

ko.L: 능력 있는 왕께서 공의를 사랑하십니다. \q 주님께서 공평을 굳게 세우시고, \q 야곱 가운데서 공의와 의를 행하셨습니다.
ko.B: 공의를 사랑하시는 능력의 왕이시여, \q 바로 주님께서 공평을 굳게 세우셨고, \q 야곱 가운데서 공의롭고 의로운 일을 행하셨습니다.
ko.R: 능력의 왕이시여, 주님은 공의를 사랑하십니다. \q 주님께서 공평을 든든하게 세우셨습니다. \q 야곱의 자손 이스라엘 가운데서 바르고 공정한 일을 하셨습니다.

pt.L: E a força do Rei ama o direito. \q Tu firmaste a equidade; \q o direito e a justiça em Jacó {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} realizaste.
pt.B: Rei poderoso, que ama a justiça, \q foste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que firmaste a equidade; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste o que é justo e certo em Jacó.
pt.R: Rei poderoso, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amas a justiça. \q Tu fizeste a justiça ficar firme e segura. \q Entre o povo de Jacó, Israel, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste o que é certo e justo.

am.L: የንጉሡም ብርታት ፍርድን ይወዳል። \q አንተ ቅንነትን አጸናህ፤ \q በያዕቆብ ፍርድንና ጽድቅን አንተ አደረግህ።
am.B: ፍትሕን የምትወድ ኃያል ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ \q ቅንነትን አጽንተህ የመሠረትክ አንተ ነህ፤ \q በያዕቆብ ዘንድ ፍትሕንና ጽድቅን አደረግህ።
am.R: ኃያል ንጉሥ ሆይ፣ አንተ ፍትሕን ትወዳለህ። \q ቅንነትን ጽኑና የማይናወጥ አደረግህ። \q በያዕቆብ ዘሮች በእስራኤል መካከል ትክክልና ቅን የሆነውን አደረግህ።

hi.L: और राजा का बल न्याय से प्रेम करता है। \q तूने सीधाई को स्थिर किया है; \q याकूब में न्याय और धार्मिकता तूने ही की है।
hi.B: हे पराक्रमी राजा, जो न्याय से प्रेम करता है, \q तू ही है जिसने निष्पक्षता को दृढ़ता से स्थापित किया है; \q याकूब में जो न्यायपूर्ण और उचित है, वह तूने ही किया है।
hi.R: हे पराक्रमी राजा, तू न्याय से प्रेम करता है। \q तूने निष्पक्षता को दृढ़ और पक्का किया है। \q याकूब के वंश, इस्राएल, के बीच तूने वही किया है जो सही और उचित है।

ru.L: И сила Царя любит правосудие. \q Ты утвердил правоту; \q правосудие и праведность в Иакове {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил.
ru.B: Могучий Царь, любящий правосудие, \q именно {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} прочно установил справедливость; \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершил в Иакове то, что справедливо и праведно.
ru.R: Могучий Царь, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} любишь справедливость. \q Ты установил честность прочно и надёжно. \q Среди народа Иакова, Израиля, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поступил правильно и справедливо.

ja.L: 王の力は公正を愛する。 \q あなたこそ公平を堅く立て、 \q ヤコブのうちに、公正と義を行われた。
ja.B: 公正を愛する力ある王よ、 \q あなたこそ、公平を堅く据えられた。 \q あなたは、ヤコブのうちに公正と義を行われた。
ja.R: 力ある王よ、あなたは正しい裁きを愛しておられる。 \q あなたは、公平を確かなものとしてくださった。 \q イスラエルの民であるヤコブの人々の間で、あなたは正しく公平なことを行われた。

uk.L: І сила Царя любить правосуддя. \q Ти утвердив справедливість; \q правосуддя й праведність у Якові {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вчинив.
uk.B: Могутній Царю, що любиш правосуддя, \q саме {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} міцно встановив справедливість; \q {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вчинив у Якові те, що справедливе й праведне.
uk.R: Могутній Царю, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} любиш справедливість. \q Ти зробив чесність твердою і певною. \q Серед народу Якова, в Ізраїлі, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вчинив те, що правильне й справедливе.

decisions.choice: the strength of the King loves justice: the mighty King loves justice
alternatives: the King is mighty, he loves justice
decisions.reason: The words are hard to join. Literally "the strength of a king loves justice", they may mean that the King's might is put to work for justice, or be an address, "Mighty King, lover of justice". Balanced and Readable take it as an address leading into "you have established".

decisions.choice: you, you: it is you who did it
decisions.reason: The Hebrew adds the pronoun "you" twice for emphasis: it is God himself who established justice.
Jacob, renamed Israel, stands for the nation descended from him.
Readable says who Jacob stands for (m3).

Balanced and Readable take the hard first line as an address to God (meaning m1), as the English does, and so speak to the King with the devotional "तू" from the start of the verse; Literal keeps the words as a statement. "तूने ही" brings out the Hebrew's emphatic "you" (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: ve'oz melekh mishpat 'ahev "王の力は公正を愛する" (L), "公正を愛する力ある王よ" (B, R); 'attah "あなたこそ"; mishpat utsedaqah "公正と義" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The strength of the King loves justice is read as the mighty King who loves justice (m1, uncertain, footnote); L keeps the Hebrew's words. The repeated 'you' is emphasis (m2); Jacob is the people of Israel (m3). R uses 愛しておられる, not 愛される, which reads as a passive.

source.text: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽ֭הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹ֥ם רַגְלָ֗יו קָד֥וֹשׁ הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: Exalt YHWH our God and bow down at [the] footstool of his feet; holy [is] he.

en.L: Exalt {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow down at the footstool of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet. \q Holy [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}!
en.B: Lift high {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow low at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} footstool. \q He is holy!
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God as high above all! \q Bow down at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} temple, the footstool where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} rests {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet. \q He is holy!

fr.L: Exaltez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et prosternez-vous devant le marchepied de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. \q Saint [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} !
fr.B: Élevez bien haut {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et inclinez-vous devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} marchepied. \q Il est saint !
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est au-dessus de tout ! \q Inclinez-vous devant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} temple, le marchepied où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pose {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds. \q Il est saint !

sw.L: Mtukuzeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q na msujudu penye kiti cha miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Yeye [ni] mtakatifu!
sw.B: Mwinueni juu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q msujudu mbele ya kiti {{deity_pronoun:chake|Chake}} cha miguu. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!
sw.R: Mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kama aliye juu ya yote! \q Sujuduni katika hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kiti anachowekea miguu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Yeye ni mtakatifu!

es.L: {{plural_you:Exalten|Exaltad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q y {{plural_you:póstrense|postraos}} ante el estrado de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies. \q ¡Santo [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!
es.B: {{plural_you:Ensalcen|Ensalzad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q e {{plural_you:inclínense|inclinaos}} ante el estrado de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies. \q ¡Él es santo!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios como el que está por encima de todo! \q {{plural_you:Inclínense|Inclinaos}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} templo, el estrado donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apoya {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} pies. \q ¡Él es santo!

vi.L: Hãy tôn cao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, \q và hãy cúi lạy nơi bệ chân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài [là] thánh!
vi.B: Hãy tôn cao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, \q và sấp mình nơi bệ chân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài là thánh!
vi.R: Hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, là Đấng cao hơn hết! \q Hãy cúi lạy tại đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bệ chân nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đặt chân. \q Ngài là thánh!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 높여라. \q 그분의 발등상 앞에 엎드려 절하여라. \q 그분은 거룩하시다!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 높이 찬양하고, \q 그분의 발등상 앞에 엎드려라. \q 그분은 거룩하시다!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 모든 것 위에 계신 분으로 높여라! \q 그분께서 발을 두시는 발등상, 그분의 성전에서 엎드려 절하여라. \q 그분은 거룩하시다!

pt.L: Exaltem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, \q e prostrem-se diante do estrado dos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés. \q Santo [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}!
pt.B: Exaltem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, \q e curvem-se diante do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} estrado. \q Ele é santo!
pt.R: Honrem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, como o mais alto de todos! \q Curvem-se no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} templo, o estrado onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} descansa os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} pés. \q Ele é santo!

am.L: አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉ፤ \q በእግሮቹ መረገጫ ፊትም ስገዱ። \q እርሱ ቅዱስ [ነው]!
am.B: አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉ፤ \q በእግሩ መረገጫ ፊት ተደፍታችሁ ስገዱ። \q እርሱ ቅዱስ ነው!
am.R: አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከሁሉ በላይ እንደ ሆነ አድርጋችሁ አክብሩ! \q እግሩን በሚያሳርፍበት መረገጫ፣ በቤተ መቅደሱ፣ ስገዱ። \q እርሱ ቅዱስ ነው!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर को सराहो, \q और उनके पाँवों की चौकी के पास दंडवत करो। \q वे पवित्र [हैं]!
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर को ऊँचा उठाओ, \q और उनके पाँवों की चौकी के पास झुककर दंडवत करो। \q वे पवित्र हैं!
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर का ऐसा आदर करो जैसे वे सबसे ऊपर हैं! \q उनके मंदिर में झुककर दंडवत करो, जो उनके पाँवों की चौकी है। \q वे पवित्र हैं!

ru.L: Возносите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, \q и поклоняйтесь у подножия {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} ног. \q Свят {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}}!
ru.B: Возвеличьте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, \q и низко поклонитесь у {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} подножия. \q Он свят!
ru.R: Почитайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, как высшего надо всем! \q Поклонитесь в {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} храме — у подножия, на которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} ставит ноги. \q Он свят!

ja.L: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を高くあがめ、 \q その足台のもとにひれ伏せ。 \q その方は聖なる方！
ja.B: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を高くあがめよ。 \q その足台の前にひれ伏せ。 \q その方は聖なる方！
ja.R: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を、すべてのものの上におられる方としてあがめよう！ \q その方の神殿、その方が足を置かれる足台の前に、ひれ伏そう。 \q その方は聖なる方！

uk.L: Звеличуйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, \q і вклоняйтеся біля підніжжя {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} ніг. \q Святий {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}}!
uk.B: Підносьте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, \q і низько вклоняйтеся біля {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} підніжжя. \q Він святий!
uk.R: Шануйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, як того, хто над усім! \q Вклоніться в {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} храмі, підніжжі, на яке {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} ставить свої ноги. \q Він святий!

decisions.choice: the footstool of his feet: the ark, the temple
decisions.reason: The ark of the covenant was called God's footstool (1 Chronicles 28:2), and so was the temple where it stood (132:7; Lamentations 2:1). The King sits enthroned in heaven; his feet rest on earth.

decisions.choice: exalt: lift high, honor as highest
decisions.reason: The verb (romem) is to raise up, that is, to praise God as the highest.
Readable names the place the footstool stands for (m1).

To exalt God is to praise him as the highest (meaning m2): Literal says "सराहो" and Balanced "ऊँचा उठाओ", as the English says "lift high". The footstool is "पाँवों की चौकी", the phrase used for it elsewhere in this translation (meaning m1).
The refrain (verses 3, 5, 9) speaks of God (m2 on verse 3), so "он" is God and takes the span where it does not open the sentence; the Synodal reading "свято оно" (of the footstool) is not followed.

decisions.choice: romemu "高くあがめ(よ)" (L, B), "すべてのものの上におられる方としてあがめよう" (R); hadom raglaw "その足台" (L, B), R explained
decisions.reason: To exalt is to lift high, honor as highest (m2); the footstool is the ark and the temple (m1), which R names as the English R. God's own people are called, so R uses 〜しよう.

source.text: מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹ֨ן׀בְּֽכֹהֲנָ֗יו וּ֭שְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵ֣י שְׁמ֑וֹ קֹרִ֥אים אֶל־יְ֝הוָ֗ה וְה֣וּא יַעֲנֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Moses and Aaron [were] among his priests, and Samuel among those who called on his name; [they were] calling to YHWH, and he answered them.

en.L: Moses and Aaron [were] among {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} priests, \q and Samuel among those who called on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q [they were] calling to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered them.
en.B: Among {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} priests were Moses and Aaron, \q and among those who called on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name was Samuel; \q they called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered them.
en.R: Moses and Aaron served as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} priests. \q Samuel also prayed to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q They called out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} answered them.

fr.L: Moïse et Aaron [étaient] parmi {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prêtres, \q et Samuel parmi ceux qui invoquaient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q [ils] criaient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondait.
fr.B: Parmi {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prêtres il y avait Moïse et Aaron, \q et parmi ceux qui invoquaient {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, Samuel ; \q ils criaient vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondait.
fr.R: Moïse et Aaron étaient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} prêtres. \q Samuel aussi {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} priait. \q Ils appelaient {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à l’aide, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur répondait.

sw.L: Musa na Haruni [walikuwa] kati ya makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na Samweli kati ya wale walioliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q [walikuwa] wakimwita {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawajibu.
sw.B: Kati ya makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} walikuwa Musa na Haruni, \q na kati ya wale walioliitia jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} alikuwa Samweli; \q walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawajibu.
sw.R: Musa na Haruni walimtumikia kama makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Samweli naye alimwomba. \q Walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akawajibu.

es.L: Moisés y Aarón [estaban] entre {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sacerdotes, \q y Samuel entre los que invocaban {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q clamaban {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les respondía.
es.B: Entre {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} sacerdotes estaban Moisés y Aarón, \q y entre los que invocaban {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre estaba Samuel; \q clamaban {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les respondía.
es.R: Moisés y Aarón {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} servían como sacerdotes. \q Samuel también {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} oraba. \q Clamaban {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les respondía.

vi.L: Môi-se và A-rôn [ở] trong số các thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và Sa-mu-ên trong số những người kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q [họ đã] kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đáp lời họ.
vi.B: Trong số các thầy tế lễ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có Môi-se và A-rôn, \q và trong số những người kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có Sa-mu-ên; \q họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáp lời họ.
vi.R: Môi-se và A-rôn làm thầy tế lễ phục vụ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Sa-mu-ên cũng cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Họ kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trả lời họ.

ko.L: 모세와 아론은 그분의 제사장들 가운데 [있었고], \q 사무엘은 그분의 이름을 부르는 이들 가운데 [있었다]. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖으니, 그분께서 그들에게 응답하셨다.
ko.B: 그분의 제사장들 가운데 모세와 아론이 있었고, \q 그분의 이름을 부르는 이들 가운데 사무엘이 있었다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖으면 그분께서 응답하셨다.
ko.R: 모세와 아론은 그분의 제사장으로 섬겼다. \q 사무엘도 그분께 기도했다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 도와 달라고 부르짖으면 그분께서 응답하셨다.

pt.L: Moisés e Arão [estavam] entre os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} sacerdotes, \q e Samuel entre os que invocavam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome; \q [eles] clamavam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes respondia.
pt.B: Entre os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} sacerdotes estavam Moisés e Arão, \q e entre os que invocavam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome estava Samuel; \q eles clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes respondeu.
pt.R: Moisés e Arão serviram como {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} sacerdotes. \q Samuel também orava a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Eles clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pedindo ajuda, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} respondeu a eles.

am.L: ሙሴና አሮን ከካህናቱ መካከል [ነበሩ]፤ \q ሳሙኤልም ስሙን ከሚጠሩት መካከል [ነበረ]፤ \q ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጣሩ ነበር፤ እርሱም መለሰላቸው።
am.B: ከካህናቱ መካከል ሙሴና አሮን ነበሩ፤ \q ስሙን ከሚጠሩትም መካከል ሳሙኤል ነበረ፤ \q ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጮኹ፤ እርሱም መለሰላቸው።
am.R: ሙሴና አሮን ካህናቱ ሆነው አገለገሉት። \q ሳሙኤልም ወደ እርሱ ጸለየ። \q ርዳታ ለማግኘት ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጮኹ፤ እርሱም መለሰላቸው።

hi.L: मूसा और हारून उनके याजकों में [थे], \q और शमूएल उनके नाम को पुकारनेवालों में; \q [वे] {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारते थे, और वे उन्हें उत्तर देते थे।
hi.B: उनके याजकों में मूसा और हारून थे, \q और उनके नाम को पुकारनेवालों में शमूएल था; \q वे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारते थे, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} उन्हें उत्तर देते थे।
hi.R: मूसा और हारून ने उनके याजकों के रूप में सेवा की। \q शमूएल ने भी उनसे प्रार्थना की। \q उन्होंने सहायता के लिए {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को पुकारा, और परमेश्वर ने उन्हें उत्तर दिया।

ru.L: Моисей и Аарон — среди {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} священников, \q и Самуил — среди призывающих {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя; \q [они] взывали к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отвечал им.
ru.B: Среди {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} священников были Моисей и Аарон, \q а среди призывавших {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} имя был Самуил; \q они взывали к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отвечал им.
ru.R: Моисей и Аарон служили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} священниками. \q Самуил тоже молился {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}. \q Они взывали к {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} о помощи, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отвечал им.

ja.L: モーセとアロンはその方の祭司たちの中に、 \q サムエルはその名を呼ぶ者たちの中に[いた]。 \q 彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を呼び、その方は彼らに答えられた。
ja.B: その方の祭司たちの中にはモーセとアロンがおり、 \q その名を呼び求める者たちの中にはサムエルがいた。 \q 彼らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に呼びかけると、その方は彼らに答えられた。
ja.R: モーセとアロンは、その方の祭司として仕えた。 \q サムエルも、その方に祈った。 \q 彼らが助けを求めて{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を呼ぶと、その方は答えてくださった。

uk.L: Мойсей і Аарон [були] серед {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} священників, \q і Самуїл — серед тих, хто кликав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя; \q [вони] кликали до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відповідав їм.
uk.B: Серед {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} священників були Мойсей і Аарон, \q а серед тих, хто кликав {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} імʼя, був Самуїл; \q вони взивали до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відповідав їм.
uk.R: Мойсей і Аарон служили {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} священниками. \q Самуїл теж молився {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}}. \q Вони кликали {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} на допомогу, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} відповідав їм.

decisions.reason: Moses was a Levite and did a priest's work when he set Aaron apart and offered the sacrifices of the covenant (Exodus 24:6-8; Leviticus 8).

decisions.choice: call on his name: pray to God, worship him
decisions.reason: To call on God's name is to pray and worship. Moses and Samuel were remembered as the great ones who prayed for the people (Jeremiah 15:1; 1 Samuel 7:9; 12:18).
Readable says why they called.

In Hindi "वे" can be Moses, Aaron and Samuel or God, so Balanced names the LORD again in the last clause where the English says "he". Moses, Aaron and Samuel are plain singular in Hindi, as in the Pentateuch and Samuel; God takes the honorific forms.
The names keep the forms of the Pentateuch and history notes.

decisions.choice: Moshe, 'Aharon, Shemu'el "モーセ", "アロン", "サムエル"; qor'ei shemo "その名を呼ぶ者たち" (L), "その名を呼び求める者たち" (B), "その方に祈った" (R)
decisions.reason: Moses is counted among the priests (m1); calling on the name is praying to God and worshiping him (m2).

source.text: בְּעַמּ֣וּד עָ֭נָן יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם שָׁמְר֥וּ עֵ֝דֹתָ֗יו וְחֹ֣ק נָֽתַן־לָֽמוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: In [a] pillar of cloud he spoke to them; they kept his testimonies and [the] statute [that] he gave to them.

en.L: In the pillar of cloud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke to them; \q they kept {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} testimonies and the statute [that] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave to them.
en.B: From the pillar of cloud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke with them; \q they kept the decrees {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid down and the rule {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them.
en.R: He spoke to them from the tall column of cloud. \q They obeyed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} laws and the rules {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them.

fr.L: Dans la colonne de nuée {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur parlait ; \q ils gardaient {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} témoignages et la prescription [qu’]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait donnée.
fr.B: De la colonne de nuée, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur parlait ; \q ils gardaient les décrets qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait établis et la loi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait donnée.
fr.R: Il leur parlait depuis la haute colonne de nuée. \q Ils obéissaient à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} lois et aux règles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur avait données.

sw.L: Katika nguzo ya wingu alisema nao; \q walizishika shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kanuni aliyowapa.
sw.B: Kutoka katika nguzo ya wingu alizungumza nao; \q walishika maagizo aliyoyaweka na kanuni aliyowapa.
sw.R: Alizungumza nao kutoka katika nguzo ndefu ya wingu. \q Walitii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na kanuni alizowapa.

es.L: En la columna de nube les hablaba; \q guardaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} testimonios y el estatuto [que] les dio.
es.B: Desde la columna de nube hablaba con ellos; \q ellos cumplieron los decretos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estableció y la norma que les dio.
es.R: Les hablaba desde la alta columna de nube. \q Ellos obedecieron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} leyes y las normas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dio.

vi.L: Trong trụ mây {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với họ; \q họ đã giữ các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và luật lệ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho họ.
vi.B: Từ trong trụ mây {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán với họ; \q họ đã giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} truyền và luật lệ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ.
vi.R: Ngài phán với họ từ cột mây cao. \q Họ vâng giữ luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và những điều lệ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho họ.

ko.L: 구름 기둥 속에서 그분께서 그들에게 말씀하셨고, \q 그들은 그분의 증거들과 그분께서 주신 규례를 지켰다.
ko.B: 그분께서 구름 기둥 속에서 그들과 말씀하셨고, \q 그들은 그분께서 정하신 법도와 주신 규례를 지켰다.
ko.R: 그분께서 높은 구름 기둥 속에서 그들에게 말씀하셨다. \q 그들은 그분의 법과 그분께서 주신 규칙을 지켰다.

pt.L: Na coluna de nuvem {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes falou; \q eles guardaram os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} testemunhos e o estatuto [que] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes deu.
pt.B: Da coluna de nuvem {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} falou com eles; \q eles obedeceram aos decretos que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} estabeleceu e à ordenança que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes deu.
pt.R: Ele falou com eles de dentro da alta coluna de nuvem. \q Eles obedeceram às {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} leis e às regras que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a eles.

am.L: በደመና ዓምድ ውስጥ ተናገራቸው፤ \q ምስክርነቶቹንና የሰጣቸውን ሥርዓት ጠበቁ።
am.B: ከደመናው ዓምድ ውስጥ ተናገራቸው፤ \q ያወጣቸውን ምስክርነቶችና የሰጣቸውን ሥርዓት ጠበቁ።
am.R: ከረጅሙ የደመና ዓምድ ውስጥ ተናገራቸው። \q ሕጎቹንና የሰጣቸውን ደንቦች ታዘዙ።

hi.L: बादल के खंभे में से उन्होंने उनसे बातें कीं; \q उन्होंने उनकी चितौनियों और उस विधि का पालन किया [जो] उन्होंने उन्हें दी।
hi.B: बादल के खंभे में से वे उनसे बोले; \q उन्होंने उनकी चितौनियों और उनके दिए हुए नियम का पालन किया।
hi.R: वे बादल के ऊँचे खंभे में से उनसे बोले। \q उन्होंने उनकी व्यवस्था और उनके दिए हुए नियमों का पालन किया।

ru.L: В облачном столпе {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорил с ними; \q они хранили {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} свидетельства и установление, [которое] {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал им.
ru.B: Из облачного столпа {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} говорил с ними; \q они соблюдали постановления, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} дал, и правило, которое {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} им дал.
ru.R: Он говорил с ними из высокого столба облака. \q Они исполняли {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} законы и правила, которые {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} им дал.

ja.L: 雲の柱の中から、その方は彼らに語られた。 \q 彼らはその方の証しと、その方が彼らに与えられた定めを守った。
ja.B: 雲の柱の中から、その方は彼らと語られた。 \q 彼らは、その方が定められたさとしと、その方が与えてくださった定めを守った。
ja.R: その方は、高くそびえる雲の柱の中から、彼らに語られた。 \q 彼らは、その方が示されたことと、その方が与えてくださったきまりに従った。

uk.L: У хмарному стовпі {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} говорив до них; \q вони зберігали {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} свідчення й постанову, [яку] {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав їм.
uk.B: Із хмарного стовпа {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} говорив з ними; \q вони зберігали постанови, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} установив, і правило, яке {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} їм дав.
uk.R: Він говорив до них із високого стовпа хмари. \q Вони слухалися {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} законів і правил, які {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} їм дав.

decisions.reason: God spoke to Moses and Aaron from the pillar of cloud at the tent of meeting (Exodus 33:9; Numbers 12:5). Samuel did not live in the desert, so "them" looks first to Moses and Aaron, with Samuel as one of their line.

decisions.choice: testimonies, statute: the terms of the covenant
decisions.reason: The testimonies ('edot) are God's solemn terms, witnessed in the covenant (19:8); the statute (choq) is a fixed rule.
Readable describes the pillar in plain words.

decisions.choice: the pillar of cloud "የደመና ዓምድ"; testimonies (ʿedot) "ምስክርነቶች"; statute (ḥoq) "ሥርዓት"
decisions.reason: "የደመናው ዓምድ" is the Exodus and Numbers wording on main; the two law words take the forms settled for Psalm 119.

The pillar of cloud is "बादल का खंभा", as in Exodus 13:21 and 33:9 in this translation (meaning m1). The testimonies (meaning m2), the plural 'edot, are "चितौनियाँ" at Literal and Balanced, as in 93:5, Deuteronomy (4:45; 6:17) and Psalm 119; the statute is "विधि" at Literal, as in the Pentateuch, and "नियम" at Balanced for "rule". Readable says "व्यवस्था" and "नियम" for "laws" and "rules".
As Exodus and Numbers have the pillar of cloud in this translation; Readable describes it in plain words, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'ammud 'anan "雲の柱" (EXO 13:21); 'edotaw "証し" (L), "さとし" (B), "その方が示されたこと" (R, the Psalm 119 table); choq "定め" (L, B), "きまり" (R)
decisions.reason: The pillar of cloud of the desert years (m1), in the Pentateuch's form; testimonies and statute are the terms of the covenant (m2), in the Psalter's law words.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵינוּ֮ אַתָּ֪ה עֲנִ֫יתָ֥ם אֵ֣ל נֹ֭שֵׂא הָיִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם וְ֝נֹקֵ֗ם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH our God, you, you answered them; a forgiving God you were to them, and avenging on their deeds.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered them; \q a forgiving God {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were to them, \q and [an] avenger of their deeds.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, it was {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who answered them. \q To them {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were a God who forgives, \q yet one who punished their wrongs.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} our God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered their prayers. \q You forgave them, \q but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} also punished them when they did wrong.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} leur as répondu ; \q un Dieu qui pardonne, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as été pour eux, \q et [un] vengeur de leurs actes.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui leur as répondu. \q Pour eux {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as été un Dieu qui pardonne, \q mais qui punissait aussi leurs fautes.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as répondu à leurs prières. \q Tu leur as pardonné, \q mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as aussi punis quand ils faisaient le mal.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliwajibu; \q Mungu mwenye kusamehe ulikuwa kwao, \q na mlipiza kisasi kwa matendo yao.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyewajibu. \q Kwao ulikuwa Mungu anayesamehe, \q lakini pia uliyeadhibu makosa yao.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, ulijibu maombi yao. \q Uliwasamehe, \q lakini pia uliwaadhibu walipotenda mabaya.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios nuestro, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} les respondiste; \q un Dios perdonador fuiste para ellos, \q y vengador de sus obras.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios nuestro, fuiste {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quien les respondió. \q Para ellos fuiste un Dios que perdona, \q pero que también castigó sus maldades.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios nuestro, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} respondiste a sus oraciones. \q Los perdonaste, \q pero también los castigaste cuando hicieron lo malo.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đáp lời họ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời tha thứ cho họ, \q và [là Đấng] báo trả việc làm của họ.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đáp lời họ. \q Đối với họ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời hay tha thứ, \q nhưng cũng là Đấng trừng phạt những điều sai trái của họ.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nhậm lời cầu nguyện của họ. \q Ngài đã tha thứ cho họ, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cũng trừng phạt họ khi họ làm điều sai trái.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저희 하나님, 주님께서 그들에게 응답하셨습니다. \q 주님은 그들에게 용서하시는 하나님이셨고, \q 그들의 행위에 대해서는 갚으시는 분이셨습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저희 하나님, 그들에게 응답하신 분은 바로 주님이십니다. \q 주님은 그들에게 용서하시는 하나님이셨지만, \q 그들의 잘못은 벌하시는 분이셨습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저희 하나님, 주님께서 그들의 기도에 응답하셨습니다. \q 주님께서 그들을 용서하셨습니다. \q 그러나 그들이 잘못했을 때에는 벌하기도 하셨습니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lhes respondeste; \q um Deus que perdoa {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} foste para eles, \q e vingador dos atos deles.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, foste {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que lhes respondeste. \q Para eles {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} foste um Deus que perdoa, \q mas também que castigou os erros deles.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} respondeste às orações deles. \q Tu os perdoaste, \q mas também os castigaste quando fizeram o que era errado.

am.L: አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ አንተ መለስክላቸው፤ \q ይቅር ባይ አምላክ ሆንክላቸው፤ \q ሥራቸውንም የምትበቀል [ሆንክ]።
am.B: አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የመለስክላቸው አንተ ነህ። \q ይቅር የምትል አምላክ ሆንክላቸው፤ \q ሆኖም በደላቸውን የቀጣህ ነበርክ።
am.R: አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጸሎታቸውን መለስክላቸው። \q ይቅር አልካቸው፤ \q ክፉ ባደረጉ ጊዜ ግን ደግሞ ቀጣሃቸው።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर, तूने उन्हें उत्तर दिया; \q तू उनके लिए क्षमा करनेवाला परमेश्वर था, \q और उनके कामों का बदला लेनेवाला।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर, तू ही था जिसने उन्हें उत्तर दिया। \q उनके लिए तू क्षमा करनेवाला परमेश्वर था, \q फिर भी ऐसा जिसने उनके ग़लत कामों का दंड दिया।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर, तूने उनकी प्रार्थनाओं का उत्तर दिया। \q तूने उन्हें क्षमा किया, \q पर जब उन्होंने ग़लत किया, तो तूने उन्हें दंड भी दिया।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже наш, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} отвечал им; \q Богом прощающим {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} был для них \q и [Богом], воздающим за их дела.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже наш, именно {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} отвечал им. \q Для них {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} был Богом, который прощает, \q но и наказывал их за проступки.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже наш, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} отвечал на их молитвы. \q Ты прощал их, \q но {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} также наказывал их, когда они поступали плохо.

ja.L: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは彼らに答えられた。 \q あなたは彼らにとって、赦す神であった。 \q また、彼らの行いに報いる方でもあった。
ja.B: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、彼らに答えられたのは、あなたである。 \q あなたは彼らにとって、赦す神であった。 \q しかし、彼らの悪い行いを罰する方でもあった。
ja.R: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたは彼らの祈りに答えてくださった。 \q あなたは、彼らをゆるしてくださった。 \q しかし、彼らが悪いことをしたときには、罰もお与えになった。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, Боже наш, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відповідав їм; \q Богом, що прощає, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} був для них, \q і месником за їхні вчинки.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, Боже наш, саме {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відповідав їм. \q Для них {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} був Богом, що прощає, \q але й карає за їхні провини.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, Боже наш, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відповідав на їхні молитви. \q Ти прощав їм, \q але {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} й карав їх, коли вони чинили зле.

decisions.reason: The word (nose') is "lifting, carrying"; with sin it means taking it away, forgiving (Exodus 34:7).

decisions.choice: avenging on their deeds: punishing their wrongs
decisions.reason: God forgave, yet did not leave wrong unpunished: Moses and Aaron themselves were kept from the land (Numbers 20:12). The words could also mean that God avenged the wrongs others did to them, but "their deeds" most likely means their own.

decisions.choice: 'El nose' "赦す神" (L, B), "ゆるしてくださった" (R); noqem 'al-'alilotam "彼らの行いに報いる" (L), "悪い行いを罰する" (B), "罰もお与えになった" (R)
decisions.reason: Forgiving is lifting away sin (m1), with the Psalter's salach forms (赦す L, B, ゆるす R); avenging on their deeds is punishing their wrongs (m2, uncertain).

source.text: רֽוֹמְמ֡וּ יְה֘וָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְ֭הִֽשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַ֣ר קָדְשׁ֑וֹ כִּֽי־קָ֝ד֗וֹשׁ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Exalt YHWH our God and bow down at [the] mountain of his holiness, for holy [is] YHWH our God.

en.L: Exalt {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow down at the mountain of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holiness, \q for holy [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God.
en.B: Lift high {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q and bow low on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy hill, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is holy.
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God as high above all! \q Worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy mountain in Jerusalem, \q because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God is holy!

fr.L: Exaltez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et prosternez-vous vers la montagne de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainteté, \q car saint [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu.
fr.B: Élevez bien haut {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q et inclinez-vous sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte colline, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu est saint.
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est au-dessus de tout ! \q Adorez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte montagne, à Jérusalem, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu est saint !

sw.L: Mtukuzeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q na msujudu katika mlima wa utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu [ni] mtakatifu.
sw.B: Mwinueni juu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q msujudu juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu.
sw.R: Mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu kama aliye juu ya yote! \q Mwabuduni juu ya mlima {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mtakatifu huko Yerusalemu, \q kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu ni mtakatifu!

es.L: {{plural_you:Exalten|Exaltad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q y {{plural_you:póstrense|postraos}} ante el monte de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santidad, \q porque santo [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ensalcen|Ensalzad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q e {{plural_you:inclínense|inclinaos}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo monte, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios es santo.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios como el que está por encima de todo! \q {{plural_you:Adórenlo|Adoradlo}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo monte en Jerusalén, \q ¡porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios es santo!

vi.L: Hãy tôn cao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, \q và hãy cúi lạy nơi núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, [là] thánh.
vi.B: Hãy tôn cao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, \q và sấp mình trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, là thánh.
vi.R: Hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, là Đấng cao hơn hết! \q Hãy thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta, là thánh!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 높여라. \q 그분의 거룩한 산에서 엎드려 절하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님은 거룩하시다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 높이 찬양하고, \q 그분의 거룩한 산에서 엎드려라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님은 거룩하시기 때문이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 모든 것 위에 계신 분으로 높여라! \q 예루살렘에 있는 그분의 거룩한 산에서 그분께 예배하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님은 거룩하시다!

pt.L: Exaltem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, \q e prostrem-se diante do monte da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} santidade, \q porque santo [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus.
pt.B: Exaltem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, \q e curvem-se no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo monte, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, é santo.
pt.R: Honrem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, como o mais alto de todos! \q Adorem-{{deity_pronoun:no|No}} no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo monte em Jerusalém, \q porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus, é santo!

am.L: አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉ፤ \q በቅድስናውም ተራራ ስገዱ፤ \q አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቅዱስ ነውና።
am.B: አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከፍ ከፍ አድርጉ፤ \q በተቀደሰው ተራራው ላይ ተደፍታችሁ ስገዱ፤ \q አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቅዱስ ነውና።
am.R: አምላካችንን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ከሁሉ በላይ እንደ ሆነ አድርጋችሁ አክብሩ! \q በኢየሩሳሌም ባለው በተቀደሰው ተራራው ላይ አምልኩት፤ \q አምላካችን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቅዱስ ነውና!

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर को सराहो, \q और उनकी पवित्रता के पर्वत पर दंडवत करो, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर पवित्र [हैं]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर को ऊँचा उठाओ, \q और उनकी पवित्र पहाड़ी पर झुककर दंडवत करो, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर पवित्र हैं।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर का ऐसा आदर करो जैसे वे सबसे ऊपर हैं! \q यरूशलेम में उनके पवित्र पर्वत पर उनकी आराधना करो, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर पवित्र हैं!

ru.L: Возносите {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, \q и поклоняйтесь на горе {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святости, \q ведь свят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог.
ru.B: Возвеличьте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, \q и низко поклонитесь на {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святой горе, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, свят.
ru.R: Почитайте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, как высшего надо всем! \q Поклоняйтесь {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}} на {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} святой горе в Иерусалиме, \q потому что {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, наш Бог, свят!

ja.L: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を高くあがめ、 \q その聖なる山でひれ伏せ。 \q わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は聖なる方だからである。
ja.B: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を高くあがめよ。 \q その聖なる山でひれ伏せ。 \q わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は聖なる方だからだ。
ja.R: わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を、すべてのものの上におられる方としてあがめよう！ \q エルサレムにあるその方の聖なる山で、礼拝しよう。 \q わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は聖なる方だから！

uk.L: Звеличуйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, \q і вклоняйтеся біля гори {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святості, \q бо святий {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, наш Бог.
uk.B: Підносьте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, \q і низько вклоняйтеся на {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святій горі, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, наш Бог, святий.
uk.R: Шануйте {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, як того, хто над усім! \q Поклоняйтеся {{deity_pronoun:йому|Йому}} на {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} святій горі в Єрусалимі, \q бо {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, наш Бог, святий!

decisions.reason: The holy mountain is Zion, the temple hill (2:6; 3:5; 99:2).
The refrain of verses 3 and 5, "holy is he", returns as "holy is the LORD our God", closing the psalm.
Readable says where the holy mountain is.

decisions.choice: As 99:5 with har qodsho "その聖なる山" (L, B), "エルサレムにあるその方の聖なる山" (R)
decisions.reason: The last refrain is made fuller (m2); the holy mountain is Zion (m1), which R names as the English R does.
